A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CARE research and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete supplementary material. Content can be reliably matched despite pagination and wording changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original CARE benchmark results, component ablations, training diagnostics, and supplementary experiments in Sections 4 and 9.

after.justification: v3 retains the original CARE benchmark results, ablations, and training analyses in the main text and supplementary material.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same anchor selection, hard-negative selection, normalized advantages, token-weighted objective, reflection-guided resampling, and all-negative rescue. Revised explanations do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use Vision-R1-cold for SFT and the ChartQA, Geometry3K, and ViRL39K training mixture. Evaluation retains MathVista mini, MathVerse mini, MATH-Vision full, MMMU validation, and both MMMU-Pro settings.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same compared models, including GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO. Comparator membership in the component, resampling, selector, and token-weighting experiments is also unchanged. Replaced citations do not introduce different evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1 and 8 and Tables 4–5 retain the same data counts, evaluation splits, rollout budget G=8, subgroup setting K=4, optimization controls, decoding protocol, and scoring procedures. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The component, repair-cue, negative-selection, penalty-scaling, rescue, and region-weighting analyses remain unchanged. Appendix Section 9 retains the equalization, anchor-choice, and reflection-scaling ablations, and Section 11 retains all four case studies.

E5.justification: Both versions report five seeds, mean results, and 95% confidence intervals, with the same interval formula in Section 8.2. Figure captions retain the same uncertainty and per-seed reporting practices.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 retain all scores, including 82.1 on MathVista for Qwen3-VL-8B + CARE and the 7B macro average of 50.57, or +4.62 over GRPO. The plotted results, supplementary numerical findings, and case-study outcomes are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(14), the notation definitions, and Appendix Section 7's proposition, derivation, and two corollaries are retained. Rewording the mechanistic explanation does not revise its assumptions or mathematics.

C1.justification: The central claims remain failure-based supervision through anchored contrast and training-only reflection, improved accuracy and training smoothness, and unchanged inference requirements. The rewritten conclusion preserves the contribution scope and benchmark claims.

C2.justification: The rewritten discussion preserves the explanations for anchoring, reflection, negative scaling, and region weighting. Section 10 retains the same limitations concerning verifiable ground truths, extremely low success rates, and possible brevity bias.

D1.justification: v3 adds a CARE GitHub repository link on the first page, absent from v2, providing a concrete code-access pointer. Implementation details and hyperparameters remain unchanged. The supplied PDFs do not establish the repository's contents or availability.

R1.justification: Several cited sources are replaced: the Qwen3 report becomes Qwen3-VL, the Keye-VL report becomes Keye-VL 1.5, MMK12 cites MM-Eureka, and the GPT-5 Nano model card becomes the GPT-5 system card. Overall research positioning remains unchanged; publication and metadata updates to retained works are not substantive additions.

P1.justification: Extensive sentence and paragraph rewriting spans the introduction, related work, method explanations, experimental discussion, and conclusion. v3 frequently splits dense sentences, simplifies wording, and removes repetition. This is a substantial language revision despite stable section order and scientific content.

P2.justification: The repository line and revised author-area spacing change the first-page layout. Main-text paragraphs and several figures shift, captions receive small edits, and expanded references reflow. Existing figure content, table structures, and supplementary displays are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 adds a concrete code-access pointer, aligns the Qwen3-VL and Keye-VL 1.5 citations with the evaluated models, and makes many explanations easier to follow. These provide modest gains in documentation and traceability. The experiments, results, theory, and supplementary evidence remain unchanged, so the revision does not substantially strengthen the scientific support.
